source_file: software modernization campaign pick deck v1 - Repaired.pptx
review_scope: OOXML structure and text scan only; not visually reviewed

slides.hidden_detection: Mapped the ordered p:sldIdLst entries through ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels to their slide parts, then checked each p:sld root show attribute. Parts with show="0" are hidden; an absent show attribute is treated as shown.

counts_definition.object_node_total: Sum of OOXML object element nodes recursively counted in each p:spTree: sp, pic, graphicFrame, cxnSp, grpSp, contentPart. Nested descendants of grpSp are counted; a group container is itself one object node.
counts_definition.top_level_object_nodes: Number of direct object children of each p:spTree; nested group children excluded.
counts_definition.native_group_containers: Count of grpSp elements, including nested groups. It is not a count of individual editable leaf shapes.
